entities.name: eCall inactivity procedure
entities.description: Procedure performed only in 3GPP access for UEs configured for eCall only mode. Triggered by timer expirations and results in de-registration and transition to eCALL-INACTIVE state.

entities.name: Timer T3444
entities.description: Timer that when expired triggers the eCall inactivity procedure.

entities.name: Timer T3445
entities.description: Timer that when expired triggers the eCall inactivity procedure.

entities.name: 5GMM-REGISTERED state
entities.description: Registered state where the procedure can be initiated, excluding PLMN-SEARCH and NO-CELL-AVAILABLE substates.

entities.name: 5GMM-IDLE mode
entities.description: Idle mode condition required for procedure initiation.

entities.name: 5GMM-DEREGISTERED.eCALL-INACTIVE
entities.description: Final state entered after procedure completion.

entities.name: De-registration procedure
entities.description: Procedure performed if UE is currently registered to the network for 5GS services.

entities.name: Timer expiry condition
entities.description: Condition where T3444 expires and T3445 not running, T3445 expires and T3444 not running, or both timers expire.

entities.name: Delete parameters
entities.description: Action to delete 5G-GUTI, TAI list, last visited registered TAI, list of equivalent PLMNs, and ngKSI.

relations.description: Procedure is triggered by timer expiry conditions.
Procedure requires UE to be in 5GMM-REGISTERED state (excluding certain substates).
Procedure requires UE to be in 5GMM-IDLE mode.
Procedure includes performing de-registration if UE is registered.
Procedure includes deleting security and location parameters.
Timer expiry condition involves T3444 expiration.
Timer expiry condition involves T3445 expiration.
